examples.title: Reaching around obstacles
examples.caption: Looking 1.9 s ahead and replanning 100 times a second, the MPC lifts the arm over a crossbar and past a person into the shelf, arriving in about 2 s. The translucent spheres show the robot as the planner models it for collisions.

examples.title: Figure eight under a push
examples.caption: The gripper traces a 24 × 16 cm figure eight every 4 s while a steady 4 N downward push, which the planner does not model, acts on it. Replanning 100 times a second, the MPC stays within 17 mm RMS of the path.

examples.title: Long versus short look-ahead
examples.caption: The same reach planned 1.9 s ahead (N128, purple) and 0.47 s ahead (N32, blue). The long horizon finds the way over the crossbar and arrives in about 2 s; the short one stalls in front of it, still 20 cm from the goal after 4 s.
